rationale: The new SEN-D1 sensor repeatedly timed out during pairing (logs show "pairing request timed out after 120 seconds"), while capacity was available (5/16 bound) and firmware was compatible (v2 supported). The customer had been triggering the sensor's SYNC button without first putting the base station into pairing mode from the app. After walking through the correct order (app Add Device first, then SYNC button), the sensor paired successfully, confirming the cause was an incorrect pairing sequence rather than a hardware or system fault.

args.action: Walk the customer through pairing in the correct order: (1) In the app, tap Add Device and select the sensor type so the base station enters pairing mode — confirm the base station LED is blinking blue. (2) Only then hold the sensor's SYNC button for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. (3) Keep the sensor within 1 metre of the base station and wait up to 120 seconds. Ask the customer to confirm whether the base station LED blinks blue during this attempt.
